_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Request for Nomenclature (DD Form 61)
summary: Provides an automated request for the assignment, revision, or cancellation of nomenclature for systems, subsystems, and equipment procured for research, development, and production purposes.
use_relationship:
Request for Nomenclature (DD Form 61) is an automated request for an assignment, revision, or cancellation of nomenclature.

a. This data item description (DID) is applicable to systems, subsystems, centers, centrals, sets, groups, kits, units, accessories and equipment procured for research, development and production purposes.

b. This DID contains the format, content, and intended use information for the data deliverable resulting from the work tasks described in:

MIL-STD-196, Joint Electronics Type Designation Automated System
MIL-STD-1812, Aeronautical and Support Equipment Type Designation System
(Copies of MIL-STD-196 and MIL-STD-1812 are available online at https://quicksearch.dla.mil.)

ASME Y14.100, Engineering Drawing Practices
(Copies of ASME Y14.100 may be obtained from the American Society of Mechanical Engineers (ASME), Two Park Avenue, New York, NY 10016-5990, or online at https://www.asme.org.)

c. This DID supersedes DI-SESS-81254C.

preparation_instructions.title: Format
preparation_instructions.content: A request for nomenclature assignment shall be in the Joint Electronics Type Designation Automated Systems (JETDAS), the Aeronautical and Support Equipment Type Designation System (ASETDS), or on a DD Form 61, Request for Nomenclature, in accordance with the following instructions. (JETDAS web address: https://tdas7.apg.army.mil/jetdas. ASETDS web address: https://tdas7.apg.army.mil/asetds. DD Form 61: https://www.esd.whs.mil/Portals/54/Documents/DD/forms/dd/dd0061.pdf.)
